name: Motor Driver Current Limit
blurb: current limit and reference voltage from the sense resistor
intro: Uses each driver's datasheet equation to go from the current you want to the VREF to set (or from a measured VREF to the current you get), and checks the sense voltage, the driver's rating and the sense resistor's dissipation. The limit a chopper driver regulates is the peak coil current.

inputs.label: Solve for
options: VREF from the current I want

inputs.label: Sense resistor
inputs.help: Pololu A4988: 0.068 (older 0.05); DRV8825: 0.1; SilentStepStick TMC2209: 0.11; BIGTREETECH TMC2209: 0.11.

inputs.label: Current is given as
options: RMS per coil (TMC style, motor rating)

inputs.label: Motor rated current
inputs.help: Per phase, from the motor datasheet; blank to skip.

examples.title: A4988 Pololu board, NEMA 17 at 1.2 A

usage: Give the driver (a4988, drv8825, tmc22xx, a4950, drv8870 or custom with its gain), what to solve (vref or current), the sense resistor in Ω, and either the wanted current in A or the measured VREF in V; say whether currents are peak or rms. It returns VREF, peak and rms coil current, the sense voltage, the sense resistor's dissipation and warnings when a datasheet limit is passed. Use it before turning a driver's trimpot or choosing a sense resistor.
sources: Allegro A4988 datasheet: ITripMAX = VREF / (8 × RS)
TI DRV8825 datasheet 7.3.4: ICHOP = xVREF / (5 × RISENSE)
Trinamic TMC2209 datasheet 9 (sense resistor): IRMS = (CS+1)/32 × VFS/(RSENSE + 20 mΩ) × 1/√2, scaled by VREF/2.5 V
Allegro A4950 datasheet: ITRIP = VREF / (10 × RS)
TI DRV8870 datasheet 7.3.2: ITRIP = VREF / (10 × RISEN)
